title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) practicing Friday
items.desc: Deshaun Watson (concussion) is practicing for the Cleveland Browns Friday according to Scott Petrak.
items.impact: Watson remains in the league's concussion protocols, leaving the quarterback's game status in question. Shedeur Sanders would be in line to start behind center against the Saints for head coach Todd Monken if Watson remains sidelined Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Wilson (rest/ribs) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Michael Wilson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wilson should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Seahawks. He profiles as a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Shaheed continues to trend towards missing another game on Sunday unless he can practice in some fashion on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Lock (elbow) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Drew Lock remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lock remains on track to start Sunday's game against the Cardinals for the Seahawks after being unavailable the past couple of weeks.

items.title: James Conner uncertain on returning this season
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said he is taking week-to-week with RB James Conner.
items.impact: Conner will not return this week. He has missed the whole season recovering from a severe right ankle and foot injury suffered in Week 3 of last season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) out against Jaguars on Thursday night
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) is out against the Jaguars on Thursday night.
items.impact: With Hawkins out, Keondre Jackson will step up into the starting role. For those who are in IDP leagues, Jackson offers little upside, but could be a worthwhile fill-in if desperate.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) active for Thursday Night Football
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) is active for the Jaguars Thursday Night Football contest against the Ravens.
items.impact: Fire up the Jaguars RB1, who has been on a hot streak coming into this game and should have ample opportunity to put up points in what should be a blowout.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (groin) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: David Bailey (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Bailey was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. A groin injury left him limited on Wednesday, but it's not a serious issue at this point and shouldn't affect his availability for Week 9. New York's defensive front will be stronger with him likely available to play.
